subject.title: Feature: Opt-in cross-channel visibility in TUI (mirror iMessage/Telegram activity)

question: Should OpenClaw add a TUI cross-channel observe/mirror mode, and if so should it be read-only observe, interactive mirror, or limited to same-session live updates first?
rationale: The request crosses channel/session privacy and delivery boundaries and could expose external channel transcripts in an operator UI, so automation cannot choose the permanent product and security policy.

options.title: Design read-only observer mode first
options.body: Add an explicit read-only TUI observer after defining channel/session scope, redaction, permissions, and live-proof requirements.

options.title: Limit this issue to same-session live updates
options.body: Treat cross-channel observe as out of scope and let the narrower TUI live-session fix land through the existing linked PR path.

options.title: Decline cross-channel mirroring for now
options.body: Keep current TUI isolation plus logs/dashboard workarounds until maintainers choose a broader observer API.

recommendation.title: Design read-only observer mode first
recommendation.body: Add an explicit read-only TUI observer after defining channel/session scope, redaction, permissions, and live-proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent TUI lifecycle work plus related PR/issue maintainer comments make this the best available product-direction owner.
